Class FragmentStage

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.granite.FragmentStage
@Immutable @Internal public class FragmentStage extends Object
Represents a substage of a fragment shader, providing custom shader code snippet to the Arc3D shading pipeline. Managed by ShaderCodeSource.
